verdict.rationale: The vendor docs say users can open the same dot in the official ChatGPT mobile app, but only "when the supporting update is available." Mobile access is therefore documented yet conditional and possibly not shipped, with no detail on platforms or feature parity. Some functions, such as inspecting delegated work under Activity, are described only for the desktop app. Missing for 10: confirmed general availability on mobile, explicit iOS and Android support, evidence of feature parity with desktop or web, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can use full-featured official mobile apps for iOS and Android

citations.quote: After setup, you can open the same dot in the ChatGPT mobile app when the supporting update is available.
